In a pre-season encounter designed to fine-tune tactics and build match fitness, Norwich City hosted Osasuna in a clash that showcased both European technicality and English physicality. Both managers looked to their benches to evaluate their squads as the new campaign looms on the horizon. A Tactical Battle in the Opening Stages Taking place on August 1, 2026 , the match began as a cagey affair with both sides prioritizing defensive structure. Norwich City attempted to control the tempo through sustained possession, but they found it difficult to break through a well-organized Osasuna backline. The first half was characterized by intense midfield duels and tactical positioning, leaving clear-cut chances at a premium for both sets of supporters. Second Half Breakthrough and Immediate Response The deadlock was finally broken in the 60th minute as the intensity shifted. Norwich City ’s H. Darling found space in the box to fire home a clinical finish, giving the home side a 1-0 lead and igniting the stadium. The advantage, however, was short-lived as the visitors from Spain refused to back down, immediately ramping up their offensive pressure to find a way back into the game. Just seven minutes later, in the 67th minute, Osasuna found their equalizer. R. García displayed great composure to find the back of the net, drawing the scores level at 1-1. The goal shifted the momentum back toward the visitors, though the match remained a balanced contest heading into the closing stages. Late Drama Seals the Result As the clock ticked into stoppage time, the game delivered a final, dramatic twist. In the 90+2 minute, with the match seemingly destined for a draw, A. Bonel struck a decisive blow for Osasuna . The late goal secured a 2-1 comeback victory for the Spanish side, leaving Norwich City with little time to respond. It was a classic pre-season finale that provided plenty of talking points for both coaching staffs.

matches.title: Real Madrid vs Alcorcon
matches.description: Watch Real Madrid vs Alcorcon highlights and goals from Friendly on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on July 24, 2026. In a high-energy preseason encounter, Real Madrid and Athletic Club faced off in a match that provided plenty of attacking flair and tactical intrigue. The contest, held on July 24, 2026 , saw both managers utilize their squads extensively in a clash defined by clinical finishing. Early Pressure and Breakthrough Real Madrid established their dominance early, controlling 74% of the possession throughout the match. The deadlock was broken in the 12th minute when Gonzalo Garcia found the back of the net with a precise right-footed strike, set up by a clever ball from Daniel Carvajal . The opening stages were not without tension, as Thiago Pitarch and Jude Bellingham both found themselves in the referee's book following early challenges. As the first half drew to a close, the game burst into life. In the 41st minute, Jude Bellingham doubled the lead for the hosts with a stunning left-footed volley after receiving a cross from Thiago Pitarch . However, Athletic Club responded almost immediately. In stoppage time, Inaki Williams turned provider for Gorka Guruzeta , who clinicaly volleyed home to reduce the deficit just before the halftime whistle. Second Half Dominance and VAR Drama The second half saw the introduction of fresh legs and a continued offensive push from Real Madrid . In the 51st minute, Kylian Mbappé extended the lead with a powerful effort from outside the box, assisted by Alvaro Carreras . Despite having several goals ruled out for offside, the French forward remained a constant threat to the Athletic Club backline. The drama intensified in the closing minutes. At the 88th minute, Brahim Díaz scored following a VAR review that overturned an initial decision, with Thiago Pitarch claiming another assist. Although Athletic Club managed a late consolation through an Urko Izeta header in the 91st minute—once again assisted by Inaki Williams — Real Madrid held firm to secure a 4-2 victory in an entertaining summer showcase.
